Payout of 8 July is short ₹745.76.
The bank credited ₹94,977.05 against an expected ₹95,722.81. 16 orders sit in this payout. 3 different combinations of ledger entries add up to this difference and nothing in the records tells them apart, so no single explanation can be given.
Suggested action: ask the gateway which entries it deducted from this payout, since the amounts alone cannot separate them.
